breakdown.description: The specified outer-boundary point load is replaced by a distributed end traction
breakdown.reason: The generated specification states 'A uniform traction of (0, -10000) Pa is applied to the right edge of the rectangle (x=1)', which is exactly the incorrect approach from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires using PointSource on the appropriate displacement component to represent the concentrated 5 kN load, rather than smearing it as a distributed traction over the right edge.
